title: TRICARE Select Catastrophic Cap Applied to Stays Reprocessed for Other Health Insurance
content:
**Basis.** Where the family catastrophic total of a reprocessed **TRICARE Select** stay (the Select liability posted less the liability withdrawn, plus the enrollment fees added, plus any amount credited from TRICARE Prime) has already reached the tier's family catastrophic cap, the stay carries no beneficiary liability; where the room left under the cap once that total is taken away is less than the liability figured under the inpatient basis, the liability is cut to that room, rounded to the cent; otherwise the liability is the one figured under the inpatient basis.

The Select liability posted is the beneficiary liability on the enrollment's Select claim lines; the liability withdrawn is what their reversals took back.

## Caps by tier (US dollars)

| TRICARE Select tier | Cap |
|---|---|
| Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | 1000.00 |
| Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | 1000.00 |
| Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | 1252.00 |
| Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | 1252.00 |
| Retiree Group A | 3000.00 |
| Retiree Group B | 4034.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, cap 4034.00, liability figured 201.00)

- Total 4034.00: the cap is reached; liability 0.00.
- Total 4000.00: room 34.00 is less than 201.00; liability 34.00.
- Total 3833.00: room 201.00 is not less than 201.00; liability 201.00.
